basic_profile.bio: A Californian native with a passion for all things saxophone and classic cars. I've seen every episode of Cobra Kai at least twice and love theorizing about plot twists. When I'm not on Reddit, I'm a part-time saxophone teacher and full-time car enthusiast. I live in San Diego, enjoy beach sunsets, and spend weekends at local car shows. I'm currently single, and my typical online hours are in the evening after work. I'm a die-hard fan of the original Karate Kid movies and a supporter of fair justice, as seen in my recent engagement with the 'JusticeForJohnnyDepp' subreddit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge of Cobra Kai stems from a lifelong love of the Karate Kid series, enhanced by discussions and fan theories on Reddit. Additionally, my understanding of saxophones and classic cars comes from years of playing in bands and attending car meets.
